analysis.overall: You had a solid 77% time in range and a remarkably stable night, but insulin stacking during a late-morning high led to a sharp afternoon low.

events.title: Evening site change
events.description: After addressing an early evening rise with a couple of boluses, you completed a site change while glucose levels settled nicely into the 120-130 mg/dL range.

events.title: Smooth overnight stability
events.description: Your numbers stayed exceptionally steady between 80 and 105 mg/dL throughout the entire night, giving your body a long rest period in target range.

events.title: Breakfast spike
events.description: Dosing 3.1u for 40g of carbs led to a gradual climb that accelerated after 9:30 AM, reaching a peak of 241 mg/dL despite multiple small correction boluses.

events.title: Post-correction low
events.description: The accumulated correction insulin from late morning eventually hit all at once, pulling your glucose down to a low of 53 mg/dL before recovering with carbs.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be mindful of stacking multiple small correction boluses close together when managing post-breakfast highs, as the full effect can lag and cause a drop hours later.
